name: Faces Pain Scale – Revised
description: Six face images depicting increasing pain intensity, mapped to scores 0/2/4/6/8/10. Used for pediatric and cognitively impaired populations.
shirleySays: Validated for ages 4–16; also used in cognitively impaired adults and dementia. ICC ≥0.93. MCID: ~2 points. Strong concurrent validity with NRS (r=0.93) and VAS. Especially recommended when language or numeric literacy is limited.
